content.title: About
content.content: Beef with tomato-based sauce (1168) is a ready‑to‑eat dish made from premium cuts of beef slow‑cooked in a flavorful sauce of ripe tomatoes, onion, garlic and spices. It offers a rich meaty taste with a subtle sweet‑tart tomato note and a pleasant hint of seasoning.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The tomato sauce provides high moisture, keeping the beef juicy.
Tomatoes used in the sauce are rich in lycopene, a powerful antioxidant.
Traditionally the dish is braised slowly, resulting in exceptionally tender meat.
Some regional recipes add red wine to deepen flavor and aroma.
The meal can be reheated in a microwave or on the stovetop without losing quality.

items.title: High‑quality protein
items.content: Beef supplies complete protein essential for muscle growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Iron and zinc
items.content: The meat is a good source of heme iron and zinc, supporting immune function.

items.title: Lycopene from tomatoes
items.content: Lycopene has antioxidant properties and promotes cardiovascular health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The dish provides vitamin B12, niacin and riboflavin, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Low carbohydrate content
items.content: The tomato sauce adds only modest carbs, making the dish suitable for low‑carb diets.

items.title: Beef allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to beef.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Tomato sauces often contain salt; people limiting sodium should watch portion size.

items.title: Fat content
items.content: Depending on the cut of beef, the dish can be high in saturated fats.

items.title: Acidity of tomatoes
items.content: Tomato acidity may cause heartburn in sensitive individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The dish is ready to eat: heat in a microwave or on the stove, serve with a side such as rice, mashed potatoes, pasta or fresh vegetables. Garnish with chopped herbs for extra aroma.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 0–4 °C in a sealed container for up to 3 days. For longer storage freeze at –18 °C, where it remains good for up to 2 months. Reheat thoroughly before consumption.
